name: dumbbell standing triceps extension
description: Standing, you lower a dumbbell behind your head and press it back up. It builds the back of the upper arm.
instructions: Stand tall and hold one dumbbell with both hands under its top plate.
Press it overhead with your arms straight.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up.
Keep your core tight and avoid arching your back.
